sampling.method: Every half-second, final frame, and three consecutive frames at all 12 joins; separate denser cup/deep-breath contacts reviewed. This is sampled visual review, not a guarantee of zero temporal flicker.

observations: All twelve sampled joins preserve the present scene and exterior landmarks without a panorama restart.
TABI stays recognizable, with connected neck/body and no disappearance or duplicate resting arms observed in reviewed samples.
Cup pickup starts about 28s, sip around 31–33s, cup is back on saucer around 35s and hands settle by 37s.
Small head/shoulder sway is visible around 46–51s; brown-eyed window gaze resumes around 62–74s.
A visibly larger inhale/chin lift/settle appears around 75–79s; calm breathing continues afterward.
known_limits: Floating light specks accumulate from about 30s onward despite prompts to suppress them.
Small face/gill contour, posture and framing changes remain; this does not establish zero flicker or exact identity lock.
Deep breath briefly lowers arms beside body despite the hands-on-lap instruction.
Action timing is approximate; this is an unapproved visual draft.
Generative scenery is baked into the footage; independent scenery edits are not established.

workflow.route: Existing Flow clip -> saved final frame -> Veo 3.1 Lite 8s seed -> select last accepted timeline clip -> native Extend -> review/download -> local Python/FFmpeg exact assembly
workflow.flow_scene_contents: 12 accepted clips: 8s seed plus eleven 7s extensions = 85s of actual media; Flow timeline displays nominal 96s. Original 10s source is prepended locally and the final quiet hold is trimmed by 5s for exact 90s.
workflow.intervention: Assistant-operated browser selection, prompts, downloads, quality checks, one duplicate-parent correction and one eye-colour retry. No further human input or new upload in this turn. This is not unattended video-story application operation.
workflow.timing_limit: Wall span includes browser operation, waiting, inspection and recovery; it is not pure model compute or a production throughput benchmark.
workflow.app_changes: None. Flow generation and guided import/continuation workflow are not implemented in video-story. P01 remains open; P02–P04 blocked pending visual acceptance and a repeatable scene/outfit/action test.
workflow.monthly_cost_limit: 30 identical-credit trials would use 2100 credits arithmetically, but this one trial excludes creating a new source/asset set and cannot establish monthly production capacity.
